Index.problem_title: Kona Compass fixes the weak point in live sonar control.
Index.problem_body: Live sonar gives anglers a real advantage — but only when transducer control keeps up. Kona Compass removes the constant manual correction that slows you down when fish movement changes fast.
problem_bullets: Difficult to hold a stable direction on target
Too much manual correction while actively fishing
Slow reaction when fish or conditions change
Attention pulled away from the water
Index.how_title: Kona Compass makes live-sonar control feel natural.
Index.how_body: Simple controls, compass-guided positioning, and a straightforward workflow make Kona Compass easy to understand.

how_modes.name: Manual
how_modes.desc: Direct control over transducer direction. Instant response, full command.

how_modes.name: Direction Hold
how_modes.desc: Holds the set direction automatically. Reduces constant correction in current or wind.

how_modes.name: Auto Search
how_modes.desc: Sweeps a configurable sector automatically. Covers water without continuous input.

how_modes.name: Direction Lock
how_modes.desc: Locks a chosen direction precisely. For repeatable, fixed positioning.

Index.build_title: Engineered for demanding conditions on the water.

build_items.title: Sealed housing
build_items.desc: Hermetically sealed anodized aluminum enclosure. Protects internal sensors and motor from saltwater, spray, and humidity.

build_items.title: Marine-grade hardware
build_items.desc: Structural components in marine-grade stainless steel. Built to handle vibration, UV, and harsh environments.

build_items.title: Speed protection
build_items.desc: Mounting bracket automatically folds at higher boat speeds to protect both the transducer and the rotator assembly.

faq_items.q: Which live sonar systems is Kona Compass compatible with?
faq_items.a: Kona Compass works with Garmin Panoptix LiveScope (LVS32, LVS34, LVS34-IF), Lowrance ActiveTarget and ActiveTarget 2, and Humminbird MEGA Live Imaging.

The system ships complete: rotator unit, integrated orientation system, wireless remote control, dual-switch foot pedals, mounting bracket with installation hardware, and power cable harness. No separate purchases required.
Via a main control button that switches between modes, foot pedals for speed and sector adjustment, and a wireless remote for full control from anywhere on the boat.
